addition.item: Drive design for the KURVE driving school with native Astroid layout, local fonts and UIkit modules.
Hero slideshow, driving licence portfolio modal boxes, and Impressum and Datenschutz modal boxes with placeholder text.
Subtle benefit-card wobble and process-card background fades, with contrasting hover text colours and reduced-motion support.

fix.item: Category publication, access level and language are now checked before article content is shown in footer modals.
Cleared a malformed unused sticky-header module position in the Astroid defaults.

note.item: Template metadata follows the Brand template format. This package includes its release snapshot as changelog.xml.
